question: What distinguishes an FPS-21 exception closure from a normal ration transaction?

   - An FPS-21 exception may only be closed after a confirmed replacement transaction or a documented reason that the entitlement was not due (i.e., documentation that no entitlement should have been paid) [07_Transport_and_Infrastructure.txt#page-2-chunk-4].
